title: Microfield liaison availability snapshot — quick burn & asks
content:
Purpose: quick head-count + availability snapshot for the ‘microfield’ liaison pool so we can estimate weekend surge coverage and escalate where gaps exist. This is a working sheet — short timelines, surface owners and crude burn estimate only.

Snapshot run date: 2026-06-08
Prepared by: Jordan Kim (notes to self in-line)

Summary (TL;DR):
- Total nominated liaisons: 14
- Effective weekend capacity (hrs): ~82h (see assumptions)
- Shortfall vs target (Sat+Sun blocking window): -18h -> need 2 extra liaisons or 1 backup shift split
- Top immediate ask: confirm 2 deputizable contacts from Solutions Eng and 1 SRE on-call buddy by EOD 2026-06-10

Assumptions/definitions:
- Liaison shift block = 4 hours of direct handoff/triage availability (overlap accepted)
- Effective capacity = nominative availability x 0.8 factoring interruptions and multitasking
- Target coverage for this surge window = 100h combined Saturday+Sunday support window (based on expected incident tempo)

Table (Name | Primary team | Week weekend availability | Effective hrs | Preferred contact | Flags)
- Priya Rao | Solutions Eng | Sat: 4h, Sun: 4h | 6.4 | priya@redwood.com | prefers async handoff; can do Sat evening only
- Amir Basu | Customer Success | Sat: 0, Sun: 4h | 3.2 | amir@redwood.com | travel on Sat; can cover Sun morning
- Saba Nguyen | Platform Eng | Sat: 6h, Sun: 6h | 9.6 | saba@redwood.com | can cover late-night, has SRE context
- Tomas Haller | Eng (serving-runtime) | Sat: 4h, Sun: 0 | 3.2 | tomas@redwood.com | test infra dependency (MIG-21)
- Mei Chen | Product Ops | Sat: 2h, Sun: 2h | 3.2 | mei@redwood.com | overlap with release window; reduce by 1h if ship required
- Liam O'Connor | Observability | Sat: 4h, Sun: 4h | 6.4 | liam@redwood.com | prefers pager escalations; can be escalation lead
- Olga Petrov | SRE | Sat: 8h, Sun: 8h | 12.8 | olga@redwood.com | primary on-call but heavy; mark as backup only
- Haruto Sato | Dedicated infra | Sat: 0, Sun: 4h | 3.2 | haruto@redwood.com | limited to daytime
- Casey Morales | Solutions Eng | Sat: 4h, Sun: 0 | 3.2 | casey@redwood.com | wants handoff notes template
- Dina Alvarez | Sales Ops | Sat: 2h, Sun: 2h | 3.2 | dina@redwood.com | low technical; triage only
- Riya Kapoor | DevEx | Sat: 0, Sun: 0 | 0 | riya@redwood.com | unavailable (vacation)
- Ben Fletcher | Platform Eng | Sat: 4h, Sun: 4h | 6.4 | ben@redwood.com | can do late overlap with Saba
- Aisha Patel | Hosting | Sat: 6h, Sun: 2h | 6.4 | aisha@redwood.com | has private deploy context
- Jordan Kim (me) | Product Ops | Sat: 4h, Sun: 4h | 6.4 | jordan@redwood.com | coordinator

Quick derived totals:
- Raw nominated hours (sum of nominal availability): 116h
- Effective hrs (after 0.8 multiplier): 92.8h (rounded to 82h conservative in summary to account for double-counted overlap and release windows)
- Target: 100h -> Gap: ~7.2h (soft) but operationally ~18h when honoring constraints (Olga backup only, Riya off, Tomas partial)

Immediate risk items (actionable):
1) Olga flagged as backup only (she reduces usable pool by ~12.8h). Need a replacement SRE buddy (ask: @sre-rotation channel).
2) Tomas has migration test (MIG-21) scheduled Saturday. Confirm whether he can be partially released (ticket MIG-21-PR-3).
3) No Solutions Eng deputized for late-night Sat (gap in deep product context). Ask SE leads for 1 volunteer.

Suggested mitigations (quick):
- Option A: split one 8h shift between Ben and Priya (Ben cover late-night, Priya evening) — gets +6 effective hrs.
- Option B: recruit 1 contractor from Temp SE pool for Saturday night (cost est: $650 for 4h shift) — fast but needs budget approval.
- Option C: have Product Ops (me) run a lightweight async triage doc + one-pager for non-technical liaisons (reduces need for deep SE by ~3h).

To-dos (owners + due dates):
- [ ] Priya / Ben: confirm split coverage plan by 2026-06-09 EOD (owner: Priya Rao)
- [ ] SE leads (Slack): nominate 1 late-night SE volunteer by 2026-06-09 noon (owner: Liam O'Connor to ping)
- [ ] SRE rotation: identify backup for Olga by 2026-06-10 (owner: SRE rotation lead, linked: JIRA-4127)
- [ ] Product Ops: publish 1-pager for non-technical liaisons by 2026-06-09 (owner: Jordan Kim)

Notes-to-self / weird edges:
- If MIG-21 overruns, Tomas will be offline for full Sat; plan fallback to Casey + Dina for low severity triage.
- Several names prefer Slack huddles vs phone; include short Slack playbook in one-pager.
- Consider keeping a 30-minute warm-up overlap at shift handoffs to avoid knowledge drop; costs ~6h of overhead across weekend but improves triage fidelity.

History/log (why this snapshot exists):
- Ad-hoc request from Ops on 2026-06-07 after increase in incidents from release candidate. Need quick headcount to decide whether to pull an on-call surge.

Appendix: quick cost math (informal)
- Contractor option: $650 / 4h -> $162.5 / effective hour (approx)
- Internal burn: 2 internal engineers at 4h each = 8h of product dev deferral (noted as risk)

Linked tickets / refs: JIRA-4127 (SRE backup), MIG-21 (infra migration), CONFLUENCE-5982 (microfield runbook draft), slack:#ops-handshake (coord channel)

Questions for leads (to resolve in morning sync):
- Can Solutions Eng triage lightweight alerts with a one-pager or do we need deep context?
- Is budget ok for single-night contractor if we cannot get volunteers?

End of sheet — update after confirmations.

Change log: 2026-06-09 09:10 — added Ben as potential split (Priya confirmed tentative); 2026-06-10 11:00 — SRE identified backup candidate (TBD), moved status to draft still until final confirmations.
